note: Recast from the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989), in English, which is itself recast from the original description of Roonwal & Verma 1971; all three castes are described and measured. The head measurements of the alate are from Varma 1977b, and a footnote in the original notes that this set of measurements does not match its figure and that the type specimen is probably lost, so the head width including the compound eyes is not entered here. The type specimen has been examined; the type locality is Chackai, Trivandrum, Kerala, India.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, paler anteriorly; pronotum yellowish brown; antennae, labrum and legs pale yellow; wings brownish, yellowish white in teneral individuals. Head and body moderately hairy; the costal margin of the forewing with a few hairs. Body length 10.0—12.0 mm (with wings), 6.5—8.0 mm (without wings). Head capsule subcircular; length to the mandibular base 1.85—2.10 mm; Y suture present. Compound eyes fairly large, oval, maximum diameter 0.25—0.33 mm. Ocelli small, oval, length 0.12 mm, almost touching the compound eyes. Antenna 15—18 segments; segment 4 the shortest; segments 1, 2 and 3 hairless, the remaining segments moderately hairy. Anteclypeus slightly raised; postclypeus flat, slightly darker than the anteclypeus. Mandibles as in the genus. Labrum subsquare, length 0.38—0.45, width 0.50—0.58 mm, anterior margin rounded. Pronotum flat, much wider than long; width 0.98—1.20, length 0.54—0.68 mm; sides nearly rounded; anterior margin nearly straight. Forewing slightly longer than the hindwing, venation as in the genus. Femora swollen; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3, the outer side of the middle tibia with a conspicuous spine; tarsi 4-segmented, with an arolium. Abdomen slender and long, hairy; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark brown, mandibles dark brown and almost black apically; anteclypeus whitish; antennae pale brown. Head moderately hairy, the body more densely hairy. Body length about 10.0—12.0 mm (including the mandibles). Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel, posterior part rounded; length to the lateral base of the mandibles 3.16—3.68, maximum width 2.10—2.89 mm; frons sloping towards the apex; Y suture not visible. Compound eyes and ocelli both absent. Antenna 12—15 segments, hairy; antennal carinae distinct; segments 2 and 3 short and nearly equal in length; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2 or 3. Anteclypeus whitish, narrow, trapezoidal, hairless. Postclypeus brownish, narrow, subrectangular, fairly hairy. Labrum large and wide, apex rounded; length 0.39—0.42, width 0.53—0.58 mm. Mandibles stout and long, about two thirds to three quarters of the head length (length 2.37—2.53 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.65—0.75); outer margin nearly straight, apex incurved. Left mandible with 2—5 and right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum long, club-shaped, widest anteriorly, narrowest in the middle and slightly widened again at the base; median length 2.37—2.84, maximum width 0.95—1.05, minimum width 0.32—0.42 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, sides nearly straight, much wider than long; width 2.42—3.16, length 1.26—1.58 mm; wider than the head, pronotum width/head width index 1.19—1.38; anterior margin concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Mesonotum and metanotum narrower than the pronotum. Legs short; femora and tibiae swollen; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3, the outer side of the middle tibia with a large spine above the spur; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate-oval; each tergite with 2 rows of hairs; cerci 2-segmented, short, 0.18 mm long, hairy; styli single-segmented, short.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head and body dull pale straw-coloured, moderately hairy; mandibles darker, the dentate margins almost black. Body length about 6.7—7.5 mm. Head capsule round, wider than long; length to the mandibular base 1.58—1.74, maximum width 2.05—2.21 mm; moderately hairy, with short stiff hairs. Compound eyes and ocelli both absent. Labrum subsquare, apical margin rounded. Anteclypeus slightly raised. Postclypeus flat, darker than the frons. Antenna 16 segments, fairly hairy; segments 2 and 3 the shortest and nearly equal in length. Pronotum subrectangular, slightly wider than the head, wider than long; width 2.10—2.37, length 1.05—1.32 mm; anterior margin concave, without a median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, with a weak median notch.
